articles.title: Okta Announces $1 Billion Share Repurchase Program
articles.mainIdea: Okta Announces $1 Billion Share Repurchase Program
articles.summary: Business Wire: Okta Announces $1 Billion Share Repurchase Program. SAN FRANCISCO, January 05, 2026--Okta, Inc. (Nasdaq: OKTA), the leading independent identity partner, today announced that its board of directors approved a share repurchase program with authorization to purchase up to $1 billion of its Class A Common Stock, effective immediately. This program underscores Okta’s confidence in its business, conviction in its significant long-term opportunities, and view that its shares are undervalued.
